comment: The nightly refresh contract (2026-07-14, from the external security audit; tightened by the same-day re-audit). Every requirement here must have a row in data/run-manifest.json each run — src/check-refresh.mjs enforces it in the publish gate (--manifest) and the heartbeat (--age). maxAgeDays = staleness alert threshold for the committed data (alerts fire even for EXPLAINED staleness — visibility, not blame). rows.min = catastrophic-shrink floor, set ~60-65% of the 2026-07-14 real counts; raise/lower only with a reviewed reason. Date probes: pages = oldest matching sources.json page snapshot (a lagging page is a finding); metrics/ptrDummy = the COVERAGE date, i.e. the min-th-freshest asOf (min = date.minFresh, else rows.min, else 1) — one fresh row cannot vouch for a cut whose other role cuts/specs stayed old. evidence: "wcl" marks requirements cross-checked against wcl-fetch/evidence.json (written by the deterministic credentialed fetch step, uploaded before the agent runs): a success row needs evidence-landed rows, not just the agent's word. wcl-dummy-raw floors were tightened to min 60 + maxAgeDays 10 on 2026-07-17 after the first verified landing (103 rows). 2026-07-24 audit (D3/D4/N5): date probes for murlok, mythicstats, simulationcraft, bloodmallet and the three page-probed WCL cuts now read the DATA's own coverage date rather than the agent-written sources.json page snapshot — before this, rewriting 106 metric rows to 53 days stale while leaving snapshots at today produced zero violations from either gate. New probe type fightProfiles covers spec.fightProfile.asOf (sims live outside spec.metrics). encounterTiers ROW probes now count tier rows, not encounters: a partial Archon parse keeps all 17 encounters and empties their tier maps, so the old probe scored 17 while 92.5% of the surface was gone. archon-hps and archon-mplus-score were added — 47 published rows previously had neither a date gate nor a row floor. minSuccessfulSources = catastrophe floor: a run where essentially nothing arrived must not publish as a quiet night. Re-based 10 -> 7 at the 2026-08-18 S2 flip (owner-acked in the flip review): the contract shrank 26 -> 19 requirements and four of the previous night's 11 successes (icyveins-ptr + the three deterministic PTR raw-WCL rows) left with it, so 10 of 19 would red every transition night on sources sitting at their honest season-boundary freeze. 7 is the proportional re-base (10/26 of 19); healthy pre-flip runs sat at 17-19 of 25 — RECALIBRATE upward once S2 upstreams (Archon numerics, Murlok, Mythicstats, WCL live) are flowing and a healthy S2 run count has been observed. | minSuccessfulSources LOWERED 7->5 for the S2 transition window (Riley, 2026-08-19): the 08-18 dispatch nightly failed the floor HONESTLY at 5 — Archon frozen mid-S2-rebuild, WoWMeta frozen upstream, wcl-live x2 in their owner-accepted standing red. RESTORE TO 7 by ~2026-09-01 once sources rebuild for S2; a below-5 night is still a real failure. | RESTORE DATE EXTENDED to ~2026-10-01 (Riley, 2026-09-03, reviewed edit — FLOOR_RESTORE_DUE in src/check-refresh.mjs moved with it): the nine nightlies 2026-08-26..09-03 landed 5-7 successes of 21 (two at exactly 5) with 13 requirements structurally unable to succeed (archon-* x9 behind the human-verification wall, wcl-live x2 on the upstream rDPS 500, both sim rows held pre-adoption); restoring 7 would have redded six of nine nights for no new fact. The same-day wholesale MID2 sim adoption lifts the reachable ceiling by two. Restore to 7 when Archon returns or by the new date.

officialNotes.comment: Separate deterministic intake receipts, checked by check-official-notes against the pre-agent artifact. These are verification instants, not tuning dates. Every edited class section needs an applied reference or explicit irrelevant reason; unresolved sections fail publication. A missed or unreachable source is also visible here after 48 hours, independent of the run-manifest's other sources.

gearing.comment: Freshness for the gearing subproject (gearing/README.md), added 2026-08-08. A sibling of requirements[] so the tracker run-manifest does not claim external gearing harvests. Current guide sources are refreshed by the separate weekly gearing-refresh workflow; failed providers retain their published bytes and verification dates. The nightly deterministic publish stage checks and synchronizes local capabilities before Gate 1. Owner-approved 2026-09-05: gearing-specs measures a local structuralSync receipt, validated against full output and current input digests; it does not re-date external loot, weapon or rule evidence. The 12.0.7 stat baseline is historical fallback, no longer a live age-gated feed; checkSpecSync validates its retained contents and provenance, while current stat priorities remain age-gated under all three guide sources. Age thresholds belong to the heartbeat, not the date-independent data validator. tierSetSync detects stale duplicated facts even when their dates are young. Existing external-feed age thresholds are unchanged.

requirements.label: Archon tier lists (raid throughput + M+ score, all roles) ARCHON WALL (opened 2026-08-25/26, held three consecutive nights as of 2026-08-27): every archon.gg application route is behind a site-wide human-verification interstitial, so all nine archon-* rows are expected to go red together. Three measured facts that a future reader needs. (1) It is NOT IP-scoped — re-tested from a residential IP on 2026-08-27, the wall held, so the datacenter-IP hypothesis is dead. (2) ITS SHAPE CHANGED FROM 403 TO 200: pages now return HTTP 200 carrying a ~2.5 KB "Human Verification" body with __NEXT_DATA__ count 0, so a status-only transport check would record SUCCESS and stamp a fresh snapshot over unchanged letters — assert on __NEXT_DATA__ presence, never on the status code. (3) There is no sanctioned machine lane: Archon is an RPGLogs property and publishes no Archon API (the "API Documentation" it links is Warcraft Logs’ own), and the Next.js data route /_next/data/<buildId>/... returns 403 {"error":"Human verification required"} — a content-type-aware, application-level refusal, i.e. deliberate rather than a default Cloudflare toggle. DO NOT attempt to solve, replay or automate past the check, and do NOT backfill these values from Warcraft Logs: Archon’s letters are Archon’s own tiering and its numbers are Archon’s own percentile cuts, so publishing ours under the archon source id would fabricate the source (hard rule 3). OWNER-CONFIRMED RETENTION POLICY (2026-09-05): retain the last verified in-season Archon letters during this outage. Freshness alerts do not expire a source or change consensus membership. The current four-source consensus still includes Archon; the UI names its retained verification date. Keep snapshot dates unchanged until actual source data is verified. Earlier three-source claims in run notes were incorrect. Clears if the wall lifts or an access agreement is reached.

Bloodmallet target-count sims / fight profiles. MID2 ADOPTED WHOLESALE 2026-09-03 (Riley, value_move_ack given in a reviewed local run) — the 2026-08-28 OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED is CLOSED. What landed: 23 of 27 DPS charts carried simc_settings.tier = MID2 (read off each chart) and merged as the whole pool; the three stored MID1 profiles with no MID2 chart (Balance, Feral, Devastation — Augmentation never had one) were DROPPED rather than held so the pool stays tier-uniform (26 -> 23 rows, 11.5%, inside maxRowDropPct). 121 of 138 overlapping target rows moved >60% (MID2/MID1 min 1.152, median 1.908, max 2.872) — the season sim scale, not a parse fault; the value gate fired exactly as designed and was acked once. Standing rules unchanged: read the tier off every chart and never hard-code it; asOf is each chart’s OWN timestamp (the coverage date only moves when upstream re-sims, so a quiet upstream reads partial and the red is honest); a mixed-tier pool never merges; the 76-byte error body is retried before it is recorded. A missing spec that re-sims upstream simply joins the pool on its night — no ack needed while its tier matches.
